title: HIGH NECK FLEECE SWEATER
description:
Background: Designed by Demna and his team, the High Neck Fleece Sweater was first seen in the Shibuya Lookbook.

The retail version featured slight changes such as a GAP logo on the chest and a less tight mock neck. 

It was first released in stores at Gap's Tokyo and Shanghai Flagship stores and was going to drop the same day on the site, as a size chart had loaded for the High Neck Fleece Sweater on yeezygap.com on September 27th, 2022, but never dropped due to the shutdown of yeezygap.com on 10/26/2022, after Ye's Statements.

The sweater features slight distressing all over.

Release Date: 09/27/2022, in stores at Gap's Tokyo and Shanghai Flagship stores
